Running it
----------
simcity.tap is a cassette image for the Samsung SPC-1500 (built with
z88dk): the machine's own tape format, at 17,000 samples a second, one
byte for each bit (the MAME cassette format).  In MAME ("mame spc1500
-cass simcity.tap"): at the IPL menu press C (cassette system), then
start the tape with the emulator's Play.  The program loads in about
three and a half minutes, unpacks itself and starts.  It needs the
machine's 64 KB of RAM.

The game uses the X1-style 40 column mode: 320 x 200 pixels, three bit
planes (eight colours).  Sound is on the AY.

Saving a city writes it to the cassette in the machine's own format and
loading reads it back: press RECORD and PLAY (or PLAY), then a key;
Shift+Break stops a tape operation.  Loading looks for the name you
type, passing over other files on the tape.

This has been tried in MAME only, not on a real machine.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (shifted: eight)
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X, Esc          the game menu: save, load, budget, evaluation,
                  mini map, options, disasters, new city
